long_biography.plain_text:
Lustgarten began in the automotive trade as a service adviser and finance manager before moving into dealership ownership and executive leadership in the late 1980s. He led Martin Dealership Group as president and served as principal of Wilkie Lexus and Lexus of Chester Springs. His career has centred on multi-franchise retail operations and sustained ties to Philadelphia’s dealer community.

His public work extends beyond the showroom. Lustgarten served as president of the Automobile Dealers Association of Greater Philadelphia and later became a trustee of its children’s foundation. These roles connected industry leadership with community support. He and his wife, Suzi, have also backed pediatric gastrointestinal care and research through a family foundation and the center bearing their names at Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia.
